_comment: Non-English spellings of the SAME high-frequency people already listed in gazetteer_names.json (English), each paired with the SAME short_form already used there — this is what makes a Chinese/Russian/French/etc. mention of this person resolve to the identical canonical token entity_tokens() already emits for the English mention, closing the cross-lingual same-event-matching gap found 2026-09-06. zh_hans/zh_hant/fr/de entries below are exact-match (these languages don't inflect personal names, or China/Breaks' own gazetteer already only needs the bare form) — see 'inflected_stems' for ru/pl, which is a SEPARATE, prefix-matched list because Russian/Polish grammatical case endings (e.g. Russian instrumental 'Путиным', Polish genitive 'Trumpa') change the tail of the word, so an exact-string list would silently miss every declined mention in real running text (confirmed 2026-09-06: real log data had 'Witkoffem'/'Zełenskiego'/'Trumpa', none of which matched the exact nominative forms first tried). fa (Persian) deliberately left empty everywhere — no independently-verified transliteration source, do not fill in without one. Chinese (zh_hans/zh_hant) matching additionally requires a CJK word-segmentation step before these patterns can ever fire on real running text — see event_identity.py's own note on this; not yet wired in as of this file's last edit.

roles._comment: Reference only — NOT consumed by entity_tokens()/event matching. English-language role tag per person, for editorial/prompt reference.
roles.Xi Jinping: President of the PRC / CCP General Secretary
roles.JD Vance: Vice President of the United States
roles.Keir Starmer: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

inflected_stems._comment: [stem, short_form] pairs matched as a REGEX PREFIX (^stem), not exact strings — for Russian/Polish, whose grammatical case endings get appended to a name's stem (Putin -> Путина/Путину/Путиным/Путине; Trump -> Trumpa/Trumpowi/Trumpem). A single stem entry covers every declined form without needing to enumerate all 6 Russian / 7 Polish cases by hand. Known residual gap: this only helps when the case ending is ADDED to the stem, not when the final vowel itself changes (e.g. a Polish '-o' ending name like Rubio might become 'Rubia' in genitive, which this stem form won't catch) — narrower than a real morphological analyzer, but covers the common consonant-stem case that caused the real misses found 2026-09-06 (Witkoffem, Zełenskiego, Trumpa all match their stems below).

role_terms_reference._comment: Multilingual glossary of the 6 role categories, per user's request — NOT wired into entity_tokens()/matching (a bare role word like '外交部长' shared between two articles about two different foreign ministers would cause false same-event merges if used as a matching token; GPT-4o-mini already understands these roles natively in every language when scoring/writing, so this table's real use is as an editorial/human reference, or a future building block if a different feature needs it). fa left empty, no verified source.
